verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lacks any first-party documentation specifically describing headings, callouts, tables, code blocks, or media-embedding support, and instead shows only adjacent editor features (page/block references, journals) that imply block-based markdown editing. Concrete hands-on reports contradict the 'fast, keyboard-driven' claim: pasting multi-paragraph text broke formatting into unwanted lists and even crashed on longer pastes, and users report severe UI lag once graphs grow, undermining the 'fast' editing experience for power users. Missing for 10: explicit docs on headings/callouts/tables/code-block syntax, embedded media handling, and independent confirmation that these specific formatting features perform well at scale.
